results.description: Very short airy swish moving a little from left to right, for hovers, swipes and cards. Open its preset in Chisper, a free browser synth, and tweak it to your needs: https://chisper.qvantor.org/?preset=aca36d0d-f69c-454d-8b71-16704878c201
